payload.body: The east berth is free from Monday. Fuel dock opens at eight.
payload.subject: Mooring for the week

payload.text: Fuel topped up, water tank full.
I'll bring the charts and the good coffee.
Cast off at ten, tide is with us.
See you all Monday at nine.
Mooring photos sent, check your mail
Got them, the east berth looks fine.

payload.author: Ingrid Solheim
payload.quote: She wrote the weather in the margin, every day, until the margins were the book.
payload.title: Tidewater

payload.text: Cast off at ten with Ola Nordmann and Anders Vik. Light wind from the south.
